subject.title: Feature: configurable /new greeting model (or option to suppress greeting)

question: What public reset-start policy should OpenClaw expose for bare `/new` and `/reset` across acknowledgements, startup/model turns, prompt text, greeting suppression, and optional greeting-model routing?
rationale: The request adds compatibility-sensitive config and changes session-start/model-routing semantics, so automation should not invent a key shape or default behavior.

options.title: Add Explicit Reset-Start Policy
options.body: Keep the current cheap acknowledgement default unless maintainers choose otherwise, and add a typed opt-in policy for startup turns, suppression, prompt text, and greeting model routing.

options.title: Restore Startup Turns By Default
options.body: Make bare resets run the startup/model turn again and explicitly accept the token-cost, latency, and upgrade behavior change.

options.title: Keep Ack-Only Behavior
options.body: Decline new reset greeting controls for now and point users to `/new <message>` plus the narrower prompt-customization discussion.

recommendation.title: Add Explicit Reset-Start Policy
recommendation.body: Keep the current cheap acknowledgement default unless maintainers choose otherwise, and add a typed opt-in policy for startup turns, suppression, prompt text, and greeting model routing.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is tied to the current reset acknowledgement contract and prior policy review, making this the best available owner for the default/config decision.
